unit: One logical leaf expression or one ordered key within a final evaluated model. Same projection repeated in SELECT/GROUP BY is one position. Shared upstream position counted once; downstream affected models listed separately.

categories.name: Numeric identifier text and comparison
categories.definition: Warehouse/loading-type-sensitive representation or comparison of integral identifiers in JOIN, serialization, list aggregation or hash inputs. Treat distinct cast leaves separately; keep common hash parent context. Do not count all numbers as identifiers.

categories.name: Default NULL ordering, including effective prevention
categories.definition: An actual evaluated sort-input key with competing NULL and non-NULL values in a group sharing the partition and every preceding order key, or an explicitly prevented opportunity verified by removing protection. Count the verified data-triggered ordering opportunity even when its effect on the final selected rank is not established. Native-correct unhandled opportunities are included. Selected-output change and whole-column repair are separate failure-attribution questions, not conditions for counting this category.

categories.name: Integer AVG including zero-scale casts
categories.definition: Integer or zero-fractional-scale inputs whose AVG loses required fractional precision. Distinguish casting before AVG from casting afterward. Native fractional DECIMAL AVG is outside this publication category.

categories.name: Division truncation and precision loss, material to evaluation
categories.definition: Intermediate integer/DECIMAL division loses required digits, despite superficially floating-looking literals. Include unhandled/insufficient only when repair corrects a value outside evaluator tolerance; include correct handling only when removing protection damages a previously accepted value. Exclude accepted last-bit differences; preserve uncertain cases.

categories.name: Time-difference units
categories.definition: Calendar boundary counts versus full elapsed units, established from actual task requirements, timestamps and engine-specific expression. Record historical timezone uncertainty. A date_trunc audit repair is not proof of historical GT SQL.

categories.name: Trailing-space comparison
categories.definition: Actual stored text-column comparison changes because of warehouse handling of trailing spaces, or an effective explicitly verified normalization. Literal-only equality probes cannot establish the behavior of real VARCHAR columns.

handling.correct: Explicit effective handling verified on actual data or a protection-removal counterfactual.
handling.insufficient: Explicit handling attempted but material wrong values remain for this mechanism.
handling.unhandled: No explicit handling. May still be natively correct; do not equate with failed output.

failed_model_definition: Baseline replays the actual evaluated CSV; same-mechanism correction makes at least one entire originally failed column pass the disclosed evaluator. Partial-cell improvements do not suffice. Deduplicate by category,warehouse,task,model.
exclusions: Generic business logic errors without warehouse-dependent semantics
dbt namespace and command syntax problems
A result mismatch with no evidence identifying the mechanism
